name: VT Crafting Helper (Blackstone Redstone Recipes)
summary: A namespace of six extra recipes that let blackstone stand in for cobblestone in several redstone and utility blocks. It is not a library; each file is a real recipe.

vanilla_changes.change: 7 blackstone + bow + redstone (### / #B# / #R#) -> dispenser. Vanilla only accepts cobblestone here.
3 planks (any) across the top, then blackstone / iron ingot / blackstone, then blackstone / redstone / blackstone (### / BiB / BRB) -> piston (4 blackstone total).
blaze rod above 3 blackstone -> brewing stand. Redundant: vanilla already accepts blackstone via the stone_crafting_materials tag.

getting_started: Craft in a normal crafting table (or furnace where noted); recipes appear in the recipe book once the ingredients are held.
editor_notes: Namespace 'crafting' holds 6 recipes only (no tags, advancements, or functions). Piston layout: top row 3 planks, middle row blackstone/iron ingot/blackstone, bottom row blackstone/redstone/blackstone (4 blackstone total). Vanilla dispenser/dropper/lever/observer/piston use cobblestone only; brewing stand uses the stone_crafting_materials tag (cobblestone, blackstone, cobbled deepslate), so that one adds nothing. Cobbled deepslate is not accepted by the other five.
